DeleteCapability.title: Delete configuration item
DeleteCapability.description:
## Request description  
This API allows you to delete a specific configuration item by specifying the workspace name, configuration category, and configuration name. Ensure that you have sufficient permissions (such as the `DeleteCapability` action in your RAM policy) before invoking this API. Note that once a configuration is deleted, all related data and services may be affected.

ListCapabilities.description:
## Request Description  
By using this API, you can retrieve a list of configuration items based on the provided workspace name and configuration category. Paged query is supported. You can use the `pageNumber` and `pageSize` parameters to control the number of results returned and the page number. Additionally, the `nextToken` and `maxResults` parameters are provided to handle pagination logic when dealing with large volumes of data.

ListExperienceData.summary: Retrieve all experience data under the specified workspace. Filter by Service Type and Data Type.
ListExperienceData.title: Retrieve the experience data list
ListExperienceData.description:
## Request Description
- This API is used to query all experience data of the User within a specific workspace. Results are sorted in descending order by Creation Time by default.
- Paging is not supported. However, you can filter data by using the `serviceType` (Service Type) and `dataType` (Data Type) parameters.
- `workspaceName` is a path parameter and must be provided to specify the workspace for the query.

UpdateCapability.title: Update Configuration
UpdateCapability.description:
## Request Description  
This API allows a User to update a specific configuration item (`itemName`) under a given category (`itemCategory`) within a specified workspace (`workspaceName`). By setting the `dryRun` parameter, you can preview the changes without actually applying them. The request body may include a new configuration description (`itemDesc`) and configuration content (`itemValue`). Note that the structure of `itemValue` must comply with the requirements of the target configuration item.
